card.text: The second interstellar object seen passing through the Solar System, and the first clearly active comet.

sources.label: Hui, Ye, Föhring, Hung and Tholen (2020), AJ 160, 92, nucleus size from non-gravitational acceleration

introduction.text: It swung past the Sun in December 2019, trailing gas like an ordinary comet. Its nucleus was never resolved; the sphere shown is an estimated size.

sources.label: Hui, Ye, Föhring, Hung and Tholen (2020), AJ 160, 92, nucleus size from non-gravitational acceleration

model.title: Estimated-size sphere
model.summary: A sphere of estimated size inside Hubble limits, turned on the pole fitted to its coma; the true shape is unknown.

sources.label: Hui, Ye, Föhring, Hung and Tholen (2020), AJ 160, 92, nucleus size from non-gravitational acceleration
